255-266 DU ;; Decision-guide table restating testing.md/development-workflow/verify defaults (unit vs integration, WebApplicationFactory, provider fidelity, TimeProvider, stubs, regression tests, probes, smoke).

C gov012.proportional-tests OL GOV-012 DEFAULT ;; Test the risks that matter and keep test infrastructure proportional (no enterprise-sized harness for a small project). ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst005.clarity-over-brevity OL TST-005 DEFAULT ;; Test code should be simpler to reason about than production behaviour; optimize tests for clarity over line count. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst005.table-over-algorithm OL TST-005 PREFER ;; A longer explicit case table beats a shorter algorithmic test when it makes rules visible. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.tst-doubles EX TST-003 DEFAULT ;; Use fakes/stubs/mocks when they make an isolated test clearer; do not mock every collaborator mechanically; do not forbid mocking project-owned abstractions when isolation helps; mock/fake architectural boundaries when that clarifies behaviour. ;; = ;; none ;; Mock/fake choice is test technique outside the oracle (EXC-012).
C tst003.app-service-tests OL TST-003,TST-002,TST-006 DEFAULT ;; Unit-test Application Services with controlled boundary doubles, asserting use-case results and meaningful side effects; interaction verification only when part of the contract; prefer integration tests when behaviour depends on EF Core, transactions, DI, serialization or HTTP. ;; = ;; Interaction is part of the contract. ;;
C tst004.testing-environment OL TST-004 MUST ;; Configure the Testing environment with isolated resources so integration tests can never reach Development or Production databases. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst007.db-strategy OL TST-007 DEFAULT ;; Use the actual provider for provider-specific SQL/constraints/transactions/locking/indexes/raw SQL/mappings/migrations (Testcontainers a good option); a lighter isolated relational DB only when fidelity does not matter, stating the trade-off; InMemory only for narrowly scoped non-relational tests. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst008.known-state-strategy OL TST-008 MUST ;; Start from a known state by recreating/resetting the isolated test DB, using fitting transactions, seeding only needed data and using unique identifiers. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst011.meaningful-persistence-tests OL TST-011 MUST_NOT ;; Test repositories/EF mappings only for meaningful persistence behaviour, not one test per trivial Add/Get method. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run004.fake-time OL RUN-004,TST-004 DEFAULT ;; Inject TimeProvider and control it with FakeTimeProvider in tests. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst004.external-doubles OL TST-004 MUST ;; At external boundaries use fakes/mocks, stub HttpMessageHandler or a local fake server; a dedicated sandbox only when the test explicitly targets that integration. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.tst-separate-slow EX TST-004 DEFAULT ;; Keep slow or unreliable external-system tests separate from ordinary fast runs. ;; = ;; none ;; Test-suite partitioning not required by the oracle.
C x.tst-data-builders EX TST-008,GOV-012 DEFAULT ;; Keep test data explicit and minimal; introduce builders/fixtures/factories only when repeated setup becomes hard to read, not a generic test-data framework for a few objects. ;; = ;; none ;; Builder/fixture technique outside the oracle (EXC-012).
C tst009.regression-definition OL TST-009 DEFAULT ;; A regression test reproduces the failure before the fix and passes after; none for problems that cannot realistically recur or are already covered. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst010.probe-conversion OL TST-010 MUST ;; Convert probes into maintained coverage (replay HTTP requests as WebApplicationFactory tests, database checks as integration tests, regression probes as focused tests). ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.tst-review-probe EX TST-010 MUST ;; Review a temporary probe before keeping it as a permanent test rather than committing it as-is. ;; = ;; none ;; Additional review step on probe conversion.
C tst011.coverage-diagnostic OL TST-011 MUST_NOT ;; Coverage is diagnostic, not a target; prioritize meaningful behaviour, edge cases and risky integrations. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov013.no-snapshot-default OL GOV-013,DEP-001 MUST_NOT ;; Do not introduce a snapshot-testing library by default; explicit assertions are usually clearer for small/important contracts. ;; = ;; Large stable outputs where explicit assertions get noisy. ;;
C tst003.no-implementation-asserts OL TST-003 AVOID ;; Avoid assertions that merely repeat the implementation. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.tst-no-assertion-free EX TST-003 AVOID ;; Avoid assertion-free tests unless the behaviour is explicitly 'does not throw'. ;; = ;; Explicit 'does not throw' behaviour. ;; Test-hygiene rule not in the oracle.
C tst004.no-delays OL TST-004 AVOID ;; Avoid arbitrary delays such as Task.Delay to make timing-sensitive tests pass. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst007.no-needless-testcontainers OL TST-007,GOV-013 AVOID ;; Avoid Testcontainers when no provider fidelity is required. ;; = ;; none ;;
